source.scoreFormula: sum per recent commit: decay * (1 + 0.20*min(files_touched,10) + 0.002*min(lines_changed,1000)); all-time commit count kept as fallback evidence
limitations: OraHub/GitLab MR metadata was not available locally; no reviewer, approval, discussion, or MR-state signals are included.
Dirty worktrees were not pulled; fetched remote refs are used for history calculation.
Tag clobber conflicts were intentionally not resolved; branch refs were fetched with --no-tags where needed.
Author matching uses exact KH05 aliases/emails to avoid false matches.

recommendationPolicy.default: Prefer top repo owner for normal tasks; for high-risk DB, C++, Java, QA, or infra work, combine repo weight with KH05 role fit.

complexity.low: Use repo top owner or any strong secondary owner with matching role.
complexity.medium: Use top two repo owners; prefer role match and recent activity.
complexity.high: Use senior role match even if repo weight is lower; consider pairing top repo owner with domain senior.
